mechanism: Both agents have nephrotoxic and ototoxic potential; tobramycin is aminoglycoside with known renal toxicity risk, and doxycycline can impair renal function, increasing tobramycin accumulation and toxicity.
action: Monitor renal function closely (serum creatinine, BUN) and tobramycin levels; ensure adequate hydration; consider alternative antibiotics if renal impairment exists.
